questions.question: How does a series differ from a sequence?
choices: A series lists terms without adding them
A series always has exactly two terms
A series adds terms of a sequence
A series must contain only fractions

questions.question: What defines a geometric sequence?
choices: A constant ratio between consecutive nonzero terms
A constant sum of adjacent terms
